caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a seated human figure with dark hair, bare upper torso colored in light brown or tan, and a green lower garment. The figure is positioned on a gray, rock-like base, with its head tilted and resting on one hand. Next to the figure is a small white animal, possibly a dog, with red spots and ears, resting one paw on the figure's knee. The figure's legs and feet are visible and also feature small red spots, which appear worn or faded. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Mary and Her Lamb
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
